title: The Box of Horrors: Better Combat Compatibility (Datapack)
description: this datapack adds compatibility between BoH and Better Combat as an easy to install datapack
body: this datapack adds compatibility between BoH and Better Combat as an easy to install datapack, making both mods work together without needing any extra setup or complicated configuration. it integrates BoH weapons into Better Combat’s combat system so they benefit from its animations, attack patterns, and overall combat feel, helping everything feel more consistent and polished during gameplay.
